controls: Every canonical data query scoped by tenant key at the data-access layer
Cross-tenant query paths structurally absent, not merely permission-checked
Tenant isolation verification required at every security_release_review gate
No client-supplied identity claim trusted without server verification
Secrets never committed to version control
Secrets never logged, including in evidence records
Secrets injected via unbound interface agents cannot read

secretHandlingRule: Secrets are never committed, never logged, never placed in a configuration surface, and never entered as plaintext by an agent. Injection happens through an unbound interface the agent never reads the value of.
tenantIsolationRule: Every canonical data access path must be demonstrably scoped to a tenant boundary. A path whose isolation cannot be demonstrated is treated as a violation, not an open question.
scanningRequirements: Dependency vulnerability scan before every release gate
Static application security scan before every release gate
Secret-pattern scan on every commit path the adapter can enforce
